name: BIAN Business Architecture
description: Service Domain decomposition for the banking industry. BIAN v12 maps banking capabilities to Service Domains — the primary reference used for domain structure in the Financial Services EPA.

name: APQC PCF — Banking
description: Process Classification Framework for the banking industry. Used for L1 process group naming and benchmarking alignment across the Financial Services EPA.

name: APQC PCF — Telecommunications
description: Process Classification Framework for the telecommunications industry. Used for domain and process group naming in the Telco EPA.

name: TM Forum eTOM — Business Process Framework
description: The canonical process reference model for telecommunications service providers. Three Level-0 domains: Operations (OPS), Strategy Infrastructure & Product (SIP), and Enterprise Management (EM). Adopted as ITU-T Recommendation M.3050.

name: COSO Enterprise Risk Management Framework
publisher: Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission
description: The foundational risk management framework applied across the EPA suite. Provides the basis for the How It Works narrative — process architecture as the prerequisite for contextually appropriate control design.

name: IIA Three Lines Model
description: Governs ownership and accountability structure across process groups. First line (process owners), second line (risk and compliance oversight), third line (internal audit).
